title: Possibility and Probability: *könnyen meglehet, hogy*, *kellett, hogy legyen*
grammar: What may be, must be or may have been: epistemic modality
goal: I can say what may be, must be or may have been true (*könnyen meglehet, hogy*, *nem kizárt, hogy*, *kellett, hogy legyen*, *elveszhetett*).
I can name the ideas of machine language work (*természetesnyelv-feldolgozás*, *gépi tanulás*, *algoritmikus gondolkodás*).
I can write a short sentence about what machines may do.

sections.title: Unit 22: Language and Machines
body: This unit is about language and machines: how a computer reads text, how sure we can be about what machines will do, and what may happen to a small language like Hungarian online.
The unit ends with a text about Karinthy Frigyes and his 1916 novel Utazás Faremidóba.
